canonical_project: Green Metro-Campus Zurich West / Campus ZRH1 (Lupfig)
notes: Green's main Swiss campus at Industriestrasse 33, Lupfig (Aargau), one of Switzerland's most important data locations; multiple operational datacenters plus new Datacenter 4 build (~CHF 70m, per NZZ/persoenlich) on Campus ZRH1; directory lists 40 MW for the campus (C-grade capacity, treat as lead). Green is Swiss colocation market leader (ISG study) with hyperscale customers incl. Google/Amazon (workzeitung 2026). Official page A for existence; B for capacity unless datasheet confirms.
